name: Ailurophobia
source:
You spot a book lying on the ground during a trip to your favorite library, but when you approach it – you're transported into a nightmare! Trapped in a room with a transforming feline monster, how are you meant to escape!?

[From [url=https://ud-game-development-club.itch.io/ailurophobia]Itch.io[/url]]
